article.story: RIVERSIDE, Calif. -- — Terry Coner Jr. scored 21 points to lead California Baptist to a 74-60 victory over Arkansas-Pine Bluff on Friday night. Coner made 5 of 12 shots and 10 of 11 free throws for the Lancers (1-3). Justas Stonkus added 18 points and Jordan Muller went 9 for 9 at the foul line and scored 15. Jalen Tatum had 24 points on 9-for-15 shooting for the Golden Lions (0-4), who have yet to play a home game. Macaleab Rich totaled 22 points and nine rebounds. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
